review.brief_reason: The only change is rewriting (0.9*theta + 0.9) as 0.9*(theta + 1) and factoring the positive constant 0.9 out of the absolute value: Abs(0.9*X) = 0.9*Abs(X) exactly under real semantics since 0.9 > 0. All other subexpressions, including the sqrt argument offset (-0.00111111111111111), the rational term, and the outer (0.005*p_d + 0.06) factor, are unchanged. The sqrt argument is therefore identical for all inputs, so the domains coincide and the expressions are exactly equivalent. Variables p_d, theta, epsilon, Ef keep their fixed roles. The result is marginally simpler (fewer characters and a simpler inner linear term).
